input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision (§2(d)) runs one way: TrueLink retains all rights in the Interface, and nothing in the Agreement affirms that we retain rights in Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property or our borrower/loan data, nor does anything address ownership of the Support Services results we pay for. Section 10 only makes Client's Intellectual Property and "all results of the Hosting and Support Services" confidential (p0065), which is a secrecy obligation and not an ownership or licence right, and §13's statement that we retain ownership of domains and Client Content applies only on discontinuation of Hosting Services. So neither the preferred position (Customer owns work product, retains all rights in Customer Data) nor the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables) is met on a material term. No assignment of our IP or data to TrueLink and no joint ownership is created, so this is not walk-away territory; the §8(d) licence of narrowly defined, aged Credit Data (p0054) is a non-exclusive licence subject to the Non-Competition Agreement and we have not flagged it. Minimal fix: insert a Client ownership subsection at §2(e) reserving our content, IP and data, assigning Support Services work product to us, and licensing back any embedded TrueLink IP.

ops.text: e. Client Ownership. Client retains all right, title and interest in and to Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, Credit Data and all other data and materials provided by or on behalf of Client or generated through Client's use of the Interface, and nothing in this Agreement operates as an assignment or transfer of any ownership interest therein to TrueLink. All results of the Support Services and any other work product prepared specifically for Client are the property of Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns the same to Client; to the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded therein, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such TrueLink Intellectual Property as part of such results and work product in the ordinary course of Client's business. No intellectual property is jointly owned under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) confirms TrueLink's ownership of the Interface but the Agreement never reserves our side, so we have added a matching clause confirming that our content, IP and data remain ours, that results of the Support Services we pay for are ours, and that any TrueLink IP embedded in them is licensed to us on a perpetual, royalty-free basis. If TrueLink prefers, we can accept the fallback of TrueLink retaining its generic tools and know-how so long as we keep that perpetual, worldwide licence to use, modify and sublicense the results.
proposal.summary: Add a Client ownership subsection to Section 2 covering Client Content, Client IP and data, ownership of Support Services results, and a licence back to embedded TrueLink IP.
